lead.title: Cologne startup DISCO Pharmaceuticals signs a $40M-upfront deal worth up to $2.5B with AbbVie for its AND-gated bispecifics against solid tumors
lead.deck: Under the deal announced on November 19, DISCO will carry out defined research and AbbVie can then exercise options for exclusive licenses to selected programs: $40M upfront, up to $2.5B in option and milestone payments, plus tiered royalties; neither the number of programs nor the targets were disclosed. After January's Amgen deal (up to $618M), it is the second major pharma partnership this year for the still-preclinical company, whose upfront roughly matches its €36M seed round (Sofinnova, M Ventures, Panakes, AbbVie Ventures): its DISCOtech platform maps the surfaceome to find pairs of antigens that appear together on tumors but rarely on healthy tissue.

milestone.title: GlycoEra starts dosing in a phase 1a trial of GE8820, the first IgG4-selective degrader to enter the clinic
milestone.summary: On November 16 the Wädenswil biotech launched a trial in healthy volunteers (single ascending doses, then planned multiple ascending doses, intravenous and subcutaneous): GE8820 is designed to rapidly clear IgG4 autoantibodies through the liver's natural clearance system while sparing other immunoglobulins. In non-human primates, a single dose cut circulating human IgG4 by more than 95% in under a day; data are expected in the first half of 2027, ahead of a phase 1b in pemphigus vulgaris and primary membranous nephropathy.
milestone.why: IgG4-driven diseases (pemphigus, membranous nephropathy, MuSK myasthenia gravis) are treated today with broad immunosuppression; removing only the culprit antibody would be more precise than FcRn blockers, which lower all IgG. Because IgG4 levels are comparable in healthy volunteers and patients, this phase 1a should already give a read on depth of effect.

deal.thesis: Less than a year after emerging from stealth, the London company founded by MIT researchers (open-source models Boltz-1 and Boltz-2) raises $110M led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with Andreessen Horowitz, Amplify, Zetta, Obvious and newcomers Greycroft, F-Prime, Hummingbird and Benchling. The thesis: sell compute on a usage basis (molecular tokens, up 50-fold since June) rather than develop its own molecules, with six of the 20 largest pharma companies already customers (including Pfizer, GSK, Takeda and BMS): a picks-and-shovels model for AI drug discovery, the opposite of Isomorphic's pipeline bet.

brefsEurope.title: FDA grants RMAT designation to Scancell's DNA vaccine iSCIB1+ in advanced melanoma, ahead of a phase 3 planned for December
brefsEurope.summary: The designation adds to April's Fast Track; in the phase 2 SCOPE trial (November 12 data cut), 24-month overall survival reaches 87% for iSCIB1+ combined with ipilimumab and nivolumab. Funding for the phase 3 depends on the merger with Neuphoria Therapeutics, which is set to give Scancell a Nasdaq listing.

brefsEurope.title: Asgard Therapeutics wins a €2.5M EIC Accelerator grant to take AT-108, which reprograms tumor cells into dendritic cells, into the clinic
brefsEurope.summary: Selected among 35 winners out of 453 applicants, the company is also eligible for up to €10M in equity from the EIC Fund in an upcoming round. AT-108 first targets head and neck cancers and MSS colorectal cancer, with first patient dosing targeted for 2027.

brefsEurope.title: Two days after its $5B Series C, Isomorphic Labs adds MSD to its partners to design small molecules against an oncology target
brefsEurope.summary: Isomorphic will deliver designs from its IsoDDE engine, fed with proprietary MSD data, while MSD handles development and commercialization; upfront, milestones and royalties are undisclosed, with an option to co-fund in exchange for higher royalties. MSD joins Novartis, Eli Lilly and J&J.

brefsEurope.title: FDA grants Medivir Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for MIV-711 in osteogenesis imperfecta
brefsEurope.summary: The cathepsin K inhibitor, already an orphan drug in this brittle bone disease, could earn a priority review voucher (PRV, resold for $180M to $210M in 2026) if approved. A proof-of-concept study is designed and funded.

brefsEurope.title: Cereno Scientific doses the first patient in the global phase IIb EPIMODE trial of CS1 in pulmonary arterial hypertension
brefsEurope.summary: Primary endpoint: pulmonary vascular resistance after nine months, followed by re-randomization of patients; up to 15 active sites by end-2026 across North America, Europe and South America. Results are expected in the fourth quarter of 2028, subject to recruitment and financing.

brefsEurope.title: The UK redefines gene therapy to include synthetic nucleic acids and genome editing
brefsEurope.summary: Backed by 83% of respondents to the MHRA consultation, the new technology-neutral definition will classify a product by whether it contains a recombinant or synthetic nucleic acid that is transcribed or translated, or acts through sequence-specific genome editing. The amendment to the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 still needs parliamentary approval.

brefsEurope.title: British Business Bank lifts its life sciences backing to £1.13B and puts €58M into Sofinnova's Crossover II fund
brefsEurope.summary: £832M is committed to 20 specialist funds and £302M invested directly in 28 companies since 2021, including Alchemab (£25M) and T-Therapeutics (£15M). A public player that has become a key LP for European late-stage biotech.

brefsEurope.title: ITM will supply non-carrier-added lutetium-177 to Canadian CDMO AtomVie for radiopharmaceutical developers
brefsEurope.summary: The Bavarian company's isotope, authorized in the EU as EndolucinBeta, will feed programs run by AtomVie's clients; AtomVie is commissioning a 72,300 sq. ft. facility in Hamilton, Ontario. Duration and value were not disclosed. Isotope supply remains the bottleneck for radioligands.

brefsIntl.title: FDA approves Regeneron's Livsayis (cemdisiran), the first RNAi drug cleared in an autoimmune disease, generalized myasthenia gravis
brefsIntl.summary: Discovered by Alnylam ($25M milestone), the anti-C5 siRNA is injected four times a year at a list price of $410,000 per year. It takes on AstraZeneca's C5 drugs and Belgium-based argenx's treatment: a comparable that validates RNAi beyond rare liver diseases.

word.definition: A two-armed molecule that grabs a harmful protein circulating in the blood or sitting on the cell surface and drags it into the cell to be destroyed, whereas PROTACs can only reach proteins inside the cell.

parts.label: Capture arm
parts.role: binds the target protein (antibody, IgE, IgG4…)

parts.label: Receptor ligand
parts.role: latches onto a receptor that leads to the lysosome (liver ASGPR, CI-M6PR…)

parts.label: Lysosome
parts.role: the recycling compartment where the target is broken down

how.t: The molecule links the target protein to a surface receptor, forming a three-part complex.
The cell swallows the complex by endocytosis; acidity in the endosomes makes the target separate from the receptor.
The target goes on to the lysosome to be degraded while the receptor returns to the membrane, ready to be reused.

word.why: A large share of disease-linked proteins (autoantibodies, cytokines, membrane receptors) live outside the cell, out of reach of PROTACs and molecular glues. These degraders promise to selectively remove a single pathogenic antibody where FcRn blockers lower all IgG: the first successful IPO (Lycia, $318M in October) and GlycoEra's entry into the clinic move the modality from concept to proof in humans, with 2027 as the year of first data.

startups.name: GlycoEra
startups.use: Glycoengineering platform; GE8820, an IgG4-selective degrader, in phase 1a since November 2026; $130M Series B led by Novo Holdings in 2025

startups.name: Lycia Therapeutics
startups.use: LYTACs (lysosome-targeting chimeras); anti-IgE LCA-0061 in phase 1 in food allergy, $318M Nasdaq IPO in October 2026

startups.name: Avilar Therapeutics
startups.use: ATACs, which carry circulating proteins into the liver via the ASGPR receptor; lead program against sFlt1 in preeclampsia, new CEO Leslie Meltzer in October 2026
